qualification.selection_rule: first qualifying nonexcluded source in frozen ranked snapshot; if first result is review/news/commentary, continue downward without reordering

evaluator_rubric.SUPPORT: primary/official source reports that the targeted check or intervention materially identifies, explains, corrects, or changes the failure in the direction of that responsibility
evaluator_rubric.REFUTE: primary/official source reports the targeted check is adequate/replicates/does not explain the failure, or a controlled comparison explicitly rules that responsibility out
evaluator_rubric.INCONCLUSIVE: source does not establish either support or refutation for that probe within the case-visible evidence boundary
evaluator_rubric.gold_class: assign a substantive responsibility only when source evidence plus corrective/diagnostic disposition supports it and makes the registered intervention appropriate; assign NO_HIGH_LEVEL_REFORMULATION only for explicit robustness/replication controls where high-level objective/boundary change is not warranted; assign UNRESOLVED when the frozen two-probe-visible evidence cannot identify a safe class without using hidden/retrospective facts
evaluator_rubric.dossier_rule: write a <=90-word paraphrase of only case-visible facts available before the corrective disposition; do not include the gold class name, corrective conclusion, post-resolution outcome, source title if it directly reveals the failure class, or query text
evaluator_rubric.probe_encoding_rule: encode all six generic probes for every case. Availability is constant. Do not encode a class by omitting probes.
